author: Animalogic
description:
The Manchineel tree (Hippomane mancinella) is considered the most dangerous tree on earth, a title it was officially given by Guinness World Records in 2011. Native to regions spanning from southern North America to northern South America, it often bears warning signs due to its extreme toxicity.

Examining the nature of the beast.

From apex predators to the planet's strangest creatures, Animalogic goes deep into the science, behavior, and biology of the animal kingdom, one species at a time.
